subject: Outcome metrics, exit gates, and closure test plan for ProtoSys evaluation
messages:
From: Emily Burns <emily.burns@protosys.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: Procurement <procurement@protosys.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial ask — MAP + measurable success criteria

Jonas,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team at ProtoSys is aligned that Redwood’s throughput and latency looked promising. Before we move procurement forward we need a concise mutual action plan that defines how we evaluate success during the 6-week trial and what constitutes a signed production commitment.

Specifically, can you send a short doc that:
- Lists the precise, measurable success metrics you’ll be validating (latency, throughput, model concordance).
- Defines the exit gates (pass/fail) and the acceptance tests we should run.
- Proposes a cutover timeline and the owner for each milestone.

Procurement copied for visibility — they’ll need the SLA draft and cost guardrails.

Thanks,
Emily Burns
Director of AI Integrations
ProtoSys Health

(Attachment: initial-requirements.docx)

From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: Emily Burns <emily.burns@protosys.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial ask — MAP + measurable success criteria

Emily — thanks, and happy to align. I’ve attached a short MAP spreadsheet (MAP-v1.xlsx) and included the key definitions below so your team can start running small smoke tests this week. High level — we propose a 6-week evaluation with three gated checkpoints (week 2 smoke, week 4 progress review, week 6 go/no-go).

Outcome metrics (PASS thresholds):
- Latency: p95 generation < 350ms for 512-token average sequence length (measured at 95th percentile across 1k requests).
- Throughput: sustained 80 reqs/minute with median token rate > 40 tokens/sec under customer workload (concurrency profile attached).
- Concordance / correctness: targeted top-1 answer agreement >= 88% against your vetted prompt set (sample-prompts.csv).
- Cost: per-inference marginal token cost within 20% of preliminary quote (we’ll provide detailed burn rate dashboard).
- Safety/PII: 0 critical PII leakage events in prompt audit; any event trips immediate pause and incident review.

Exit gates and acceptance tests (how we validate):
1) Week 2 — Smoke gate (internal owner: jonas_weber):
  - Run 200 sample prompts from sample-prompts.csv across the same model variant and measure p95 latency and concordance.
  - Validate KV cache effectiveness via prefix-resend test (expect >15% token cost reduction on repeated flows).
  - Security: run redacted-prompt audit (automated) and confirm no infra exposures.
  - Pass if latency AND concordance thresholds met; otherwise we triage blockers.

2) Week 4 — Stability & cost gate (owner: karthik_iyer):
  - 24-hour soak test at expected peak QPS (2x expected) with monitoring for tail latency spikes and error rate <0.5%.
  - Collect token burn samples and compare to cost target; if over 20%, propose quantization/batching config changes.
  - Confirm canary fallback works (auto-route to smaller model variant with <5% drop in concordance).
  - Pass requires soak test stability AND cost within 20% of quote OR documented plan with mitigations accepted by ProtoSys.

3) Week 6 — Go/no-go (owner: marissa_cole):
  - Run full acceptance test suite (500 prompts including edge cases) and measure: p95 latency, throughput, top-1 concordance, and end-to-end transactional latency when integrated with your API proxy.
  - Validate logging/audit trail completeness and that retention policy meets your compliance needs.
  - Legal/procurement signoffs on SLA-draft.pdf and DocuSign executed.
  - Pass = all measurable thresholds met OR executive-approved exception (both sides sign off on a remediation plan + timeline).

Risks and break-glass triggers:
- Critical safety finding (PII/sensitive-data leakage) -> immediate pause + joint incident review.
- Sustained error rate >1% during soak -> rollback to previously agreed model variant.
- Cost burn >40% over quoted estimate before week 4 -> optional early termination with 30-day notice.

Deliverables we’ll attach: MAP-v1.xlsx (milestone owners & dates), sample-prompts.csv, SLA-draft.pdf. I’ll also open a HubSpot activity (link below) and create a shared runbook in Drive if you want editable test cases.

Proposed timeline (dates tentative):
- Week 0 (kickoff): 2027-07-05 — MAP signoff + provisioning begins (owner: marissa_cole).
- Week 2 smoke: 2027-07-19 — smoke test results and blocker triage (owner: jonas_weber).
- Week 4 soak/review: 2027-08-02 — soak test and cost review (owner: karthik_iyer).
- Week 6 go/no-go: 2027-08-16 — acceptance test and procurement signoff (owner: marissa_cole).

Let me know if you want any thresholds tightened or additional acceptance checks (e.g., per-endpoint latency SLOs). I can update MAP-v1 and re-share.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai

(Attachments: MAP-v1.xlsx, sample-prompts.csv, SLA-draft.pdf)

From: Emily Burns <emily.burns@protosys.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: Procurement <procurement@protosys.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 29 Jun 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial ask — MAP + measurable success criteria

Jonas — this is exactly what we needed, thank you. A few quick clarifications from the engineering and procurement teams:
- For the concordance metric, we’ll provide a gold set (n=1,000) — confirm whether you’ll run strict string-match or semantic similarity scoring and share the scoring script.
- Procurement asks that the SLA-draft include an option for a 99.9% availability SLO for the production contract; we can accept 99.7% during evaluation.
- Can the week-2 smoke be run in our staging environment (we’ll provide VPN access and a temporary service account)?

We’re good to sign the MAP once you add the scoring script note and the staging access steps. Procurement is standing by for the SLA language and DocuSign when ready.

Emily Burns
Director of AI Integrations
ProtoSys Health

(Attachment: proto-requirements-v1.pdf)

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: Emily Burns <emily.burns@protosys.com>, jonas_weber@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial ask — MAP + measurable success criteria (MAP finalized & next steps)

Emily / team — quick confirmation from Redwood leadership: we’ll update MAP-v1 with the concordance scoring notes (we support both strict match and cosine-similarity with a provided script; default will be semantic score with threshold tuned to your gold set).

Action items we will complete before the kickoff (2027-07-05):
- marissa_cole: finalize MAP-v1.xlsx with owners, attach the DocuSign envelope for the MAP and SLA-draft.pdf.
- jonas_weber: add scoring script and a short runbook for running the smoke suite in your staging (including VPN/service-account steps).
- karthik_iyer: prepare soak test harness and cost dashboard access for your finance team.

We will send the DocuSign link to Procurement by end of day tomorrow. Once executed we’ll provision the dedicated trial capacity and share access credentials. Looking forward to working with ProtoSys.

Best,
Marissa Cole
VP, Sales Operations — Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

(Attachments: MAP-v1.xlsx (updated pending), SLA-draft.pdf, DocuSign envelope seat reserved)
